attchmntText: Global Education Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Corrigendum to the Outcome of Board Meeting dated 12 November 2026   Rectification of Inadvertent Clerical Error in Standalone and Consolidated Segment Reporting for the Quarter and Half Year Ended 30 September 2026'.
voiceSummary: Global Education Limited issued a corrigendum to the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12 November 2026. The company rectified an inadvertent clerical error in the Standalone and Consolidated Segment Reporting for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The amount under Interest and Financial Charges was corrected from 0.14 lakh to 0.47 lakh. Adjustments aggregating to 0.33 lakh were made in Educational Training and Business Support segments. The company confirmed that Revenue, Total Expenses, Profit Before Tax, Profit After Tax, and Earnings Per Share remain unchanged. The revised financial results are enclosed for record. Statutory auditors Patel Shah and Joshi have issued an unmodified limited review report on the corrected disclosures.

attchmntText: Global Education Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Corrigendum to to the Outcome of Board Meeting dated 12 November 2026   Rectification of Inadvertent Clerical Error in Standalone and Consolidated Segment Reporting for the Quarter and Half Year Ended 30 September 2026
voiceSummary: Global Education Limited issued a corrigendum to the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12 November 2026. The company corrected an inadvertent clerical error in the Standalone and Consolidated Segment Reporting for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The amount under Less Interest and Financial Charges was reported as 0.14 lakh instead of 0.47 lakh. Adjustments aggregating to 0.33 lakh were made in Educational Training and Development Activities and Business Support Activities. The corrections are restricted to Segment Reporting disclosures. There is no change in Revenue, Total Expenses, Profit Before Tax, Profit After Tax, or Earnings Per Share. The revised financial results are enclosed for record.

attchmntText: Global Education Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Global Education Limited board held its fourth meeting for the financial year 2026-2027 on 12th November 2026. The board approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Statutory auditors Patel Shah and Joshi issued limited review reports on these results. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 2626.28 lacs. Net profit for the period was Rs. 1940.31 lacs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 3.81. Total assets as of 30 September 2026 were Rs. 15887.38 lacs. The company reported no default on loans or debt securities. Related party transactions were disclosed as applicable. The financial results are available on the company website.
